testcase.name: Scenario: Move a grouped control into and out of an expanded panel: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:180:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move a grouped control into and out of an expanded panel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the grouped "Plane" control is in the 3D Model Work Features main panel ✔ When the user right-clicks "Plane" and selects "Move to Expanded Panel" ✔ Then "Plane" is no longer visible in the main panel ✔ When the user opens the Work Features expansion ✔ Then a "Plane" control appears in the expanded area ✔ And its context menu offers "Ungroup Commands from Drop-Down Menu" ✔ When the user selects "Move to Main Panel" from that context menu ✔ Then "Plane" returns to the main panel ✔ And the part remains active
